Title: In development: New planned datacenter region in Belgium (Belgium Central)

Body.Content:
Microsoft will establish a new datacenter region in the country, offering Belgian organizations local data residency and faster access to the cloud, delivering advanced data security and cloud solutions. The new datacenter region will also include Availability Zones, providing customers with high availability and additional tolerance to datacenter failures. 

Learn more.
